messages:
alex: Quick sync  we have KMS staging cutover + SOC2 evidence handover next week. Who will own the export, upload, and sign-off? Need owners before EOD Fri.
maria: I can own artifact collection and the initial upload (exported ACL snapshot, rotation CSV, keystore ops, HSM attestation). Will need infra help for precise query scopes and retention windows.
jamal: Ill handle infra side. @maria please post exact dataset/table names and target GCS path so I don't over-export.
maria: List:
- dataset: redwood_prod.audit.kms_access_grants (snapshot)
- envelope_rotations table -> envelope_rotation_90d.csv
- keystore_ops (create/delete) last 90 days
- hsm_attestation_latest.pdf (vendor API)
- auditflow run log timestamps
Target bucket: gs://redwood-priv-audit/kms-cutover/2026-03

jamal: Plan: BigQuery export -> gsutil compose -> gzip -> add sha256 checksum + manifest.json. Schedule outside backup window.
infra-bot: Heads-up: full backups 02:30-03:30 UTC daily; export queries may be queued. Recommend starting after 04:00 UTC.

maria: Good call infra-bot. @jamal can you target Mon 04:15 UTC and include checksums and manifest with file list + b64-encoded sha256?
jamal: Yes. I'll do Mon 04:15. Will include gsutil hash output and manifest. Also will redact any PII fields per compliance mapping.

alex: Who will do the runbook handshake during cutover? Need someone oncall to validate artifacts and confirm sign-off to the SOC2 tracker.
sophia: I can be oncall Mon 03:00-07:00 UTC. I'll join the runbook walk-through and confirm sign-off after validation. Please add me to runbook access.
security-bot: Reminder: auditors expect HSM attestation PDFs to include SigInfo header and timestamp. Please verify before upload.

maria: Can someone run a quick HSM attestation retrieval dry-run and confirm format? If vendor API rate-limits, fallback is /secure/attestations/ archive.
jamal: I'll fetch a sample from staging. Note vendor limit 10/min; will throttle and fall back if needed.
sophia: I'll add the fallback and verification checklist to the runbook in a tiny PR after this thread.

alex: Ownership recap: @maria = artifacts + upload, @jamal = export + integrity, @sophia = oncall handshake + sign-off. Security will be notified after upload.
maria: ETA: exports scheduled Mon 04:15, upload + checksums by 09:30 UTC, notify security by 10:00 UTC.
jamal: Confirmed export scheduled and manifest will be in gs://redwood-priv-audit/kms-cutover/2026-03 by 09:30 UTC.
sophia: I'll validate artifacts by 11:00 UTC and post sign-off in the SOC2 tracker channel. If anything blocks, ping here.
alex: Thanks all. If any blockers crop up before Friday, call them out here so we can escalate to program PM. :thumbsup:
